evidence.activity: Mid-level manager development program for employees
evidence.quote: We have a mid-level manager development program, in which participants learn leadership skills, network with peers and senior executives, and tackle critical initiatives.

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: E-learning platform offering job, career and professional development courses to employees
evidence.quote: In addition, we provide employees with access to an e-learning platform that offers courses focused on job and career training, business acumen, professional development and technical capabilities.

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Brand marketing that includes sponsorship of bands and esports among many promotional tactics
evidence.quote: We support our non-alcohol brands with prize promotions, price promotions, competitions, endorsements from selected public and sports figures, sports personality endorsements, influencer endorsements, collaborations, sampling and sponsorship of selected athletes, teams, series, bands, esports, causes and events.

creativity.criterion: level 1: creative work used as a routine marketing input; no named arts sponsorship or reach disclosed

evidence.activity: In-house redesign of product labels and graphics
evidence.quote: The labels and graphics for many of our products are redesigned and refreshed from time to time to maximize their visibility and identification, wherever they may be placed in stores, which designs we continue to reevaluate from time to time.

creativity.criterion: level 1: product design used as a routine business input

creativity.reason: Level 1: creative work appears only as a routine business input (band sponsorships listed among marketing tactics and label redesign), with no business that creates or enables creative work.

community.reason: Level 2: the filing describes only employee development programs (manager development, leadership platform, e-learning), so Community is capped at 2.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 0: the Human Capital section is long enough to judge, and it shows no employee networks, inclusive practices, accessibility, multilingual or underserved-customer programs; international operations and regional headcounts do not count.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 0: the business description shows no service or program enabling founders or small businesses; small companies are mentioned only as competitors.

ai.notes: The Item 7 targeted excerpt was empty, so it contained no MD&A paragraphs mentioning the theme terms. Band and esports sponsorship is listed only as a generic brand-marketing tactic with no named program or reach, so it was scored as uses_as_input and not as an arts sponsorship (when torn between levels, the lower one was chosen). Trademark licensing for merchandise and craft-beer branding were not treated as creative enabling. The Human Capital section gives headcounts by geographic region, which are not demographic statistics about backgrounds and were not scored. Traps excluded: small competitors, the small-brewer excise tax, and 'identity theft assistance' in benefits.
